notes.title: Public demo available NOW!
notes.content:
Sands Of Hope is having a FREE playable Demo!


We're happy to announce that a public demo is available for you to play now, and that it will take part in the Steam's Next Fest!



This is your chance to take a first step into Hope's adventure. If you enjoy your time with the demo, we'd be so grateful if you leave a review :)



Also, if you want to leave some feedback, please let us know your comments and suggestions via e-mail with the subject "feedback", we'll appreciate it!



contact@guatekestudios.com
